verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes some timeline information. It lists expedited case preparation in under 3 weeks on the Plus tier and shows an average-days-to-submission counter on the homepage. On the government side, its EB-1A guide states premium processing gives a 15-business-day decision. Missing for 10: standard (non-Plus) preparation timelines, regular USCIS processing times for each visa type, per-visa end-to-end timeline tables, and independent corroboration of the published timeframes.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on

citations.quote: Premium processing delivers a 15-business-day decision on EB-1A petitions
